title: claude-usage video storyboard
description: What /claude-usage:video shows, scene by scene. video.py plan drafts it from metrics.json, insights.json and optimizations.json; Claude edits the words and the choice of scenes; video.py check and render enforce it. It never holds figures: each scene names what to show (tiles, insight ids, optimization ids, levers, a miss trace) and video.py takes every number from the data files. Numbers written in a headline, eyebrow or title must match one of those figures.

metrics_generated.description: meta.generated of the metrics.json the storyboard was planned from; a newer report needs a new plan

allow_names.description: true only when the user asked to show project names, session titles or file paths; the check refuses them otherwise

type.description: intro: total cost and daily spend. numbers: headline tiles. models: cost by model and by token type. miss: the timeline of one costly cache miss. insights: top insights with their savings. levers: what each lever would have saved (SV2). optimizations: the changes, applied or not. savings: what the changes together would have saved, overlaps removed.

eyebrow.description: Small label above the headline; defaults per scene type

tiles.description: numbers: headline tile labels, as the report names them

trace.description: miss: a trace id from the report's step-by-step section (default: the costliest)

items.description: insights (1-3): insight ids with a saving; optimizations (1-4): optimization ids; levers (2-5): lever names from SV2. An object form sets a shorter title.
